title: Construction Site Complaint
description: Use this service request for issues and concerns caused by construction sites, such as trash and debris left behind by construction crews, no erosion control, and mud being tracked into the street. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 2 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 complaint about a construction site.
actions.why: Report construction-site concerns such as trash or debris left by crews, absent erosion controls, mud tracked into the street, high weeds, missing permit signs, damaged streets or sidewalks, public right-of-way use, or construction noise. The 311 request form also asks whether sediment is tracking into a street or alley or concrete is washing out. For noise complaints and work unrelated to a building permit, the 311 request form offers other service suggestions while allowing the current request to continue.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Construction Site Complaint"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Construction Site Complaint"

actions.tagline: Consider a 311 Code Concerns request for construction-site noise.
actions.why: For a construction-site noise complaint. The 311 request form for "Construction Site Complaint" requests suggests Code Concerns while allowing the current service to continue; the Code Concerns form includes construction during prohibited hours among noise issues.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"

actions.tagline: Consider a 311 request for construction outside the scope of a building permit.
actions.why: For active construction believed to be outside the scope of a permit or approved plans. The 311 request form for "Construction Site Complaint" requests suggests Building Permits Violation for construction not related to a building permit while allowing the current service to continue.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Building Permits Violation"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Building Permits Violation"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about urgent construction-site runoff or sediment.
actions.why: For sediment or mud from a construction site tracking into a street or alley, concrete washout, or other illicit discharge or pollution from construction reaching a street, alley, ditch, waterway, or storm drain. The 311 request form for "Construction Site Complaint" requests suggests Storm Water Construction Site Urgent for sediment tracking or concrete washout; that service must be dispatched by phone.
actions.how: Call 311 and ask for "Storm Water Construction Site Urgent"
actions.how_formatted: Call [311](tel:311) and ask for "Storm Water Construction Site Urgent"
